requirements.text: CDN peering allows different CDN providers to share resources.
requirements.source_sentence: CDN peering allows different CDN providers to share resources in order to provide larger scale and/or reach to each participant than they could not achieve otherwise.

requirements.text: CDN peering is formed by a set of autonomous CDNs.
requirements.source_sentence: It is formed by a set of autonomous CDNs, which cooperate through a mechanism that provides facilities and infrastructure for cooperation in order to virtualize multiple providers.

requirements.text: An effective peering arrangement between CDNs requires multiple steps to occur.
requirements.source_sentence: It is expected that an effective peering arrangement between CDNs would require multiple steps to occur.

requirements.text: Peering allows a particular CDN to achieve larger scale and reach through resource sharing with other CDNs.
actions: achieve larger scale and reach through resource sharing
requirements.source_sentence: Peering allows a particular CDN to achieve larger scale/reach through resource sharing with other CDN(s).

requirements.text: Peering enables the CDNs to exchange accounting information for billing based on the negotiated relationships.
requirements.source_sentence: Peering also enables the CDNs to exchange accounting information to perform billing based on the negotiated relationships.

requirements.text: If no CDN is interested in such peering, peering arrangement creation through re-negotiation is resumed by tuning the negotiated relationships with reconsidered service requirements.
actions: resume peering arrangement creation through re-negotiation
conditions: no CDN is interested in such peering
requirements.source_sentence: If no CDN is interested in such peering, peering arrangement creation through re-negotiation is resumed by tuning the negotiated relationships with reconsidered service requirements.

requirements.text: An existing peering arrangement may need to disband itself if the circumstances under which the arrangement was formed no longer hold.
conditions: circumstances under which the arrangement was formed no longer hold
requirements.source_sentence: An existing peering arrangement may need to either disband or re-arrange itself (within the scope of the negotiated relationships) if any of the following conditions hold: (a) the circumstances under which the arrangement was formed no longer hold; (b) peering is no longer beneficial for the participating CDNs; (c) an existing peering arrangement needs to be expanded further in order to deal with additional load; or (d) participating CDNs are not meeting their agreed upon contributions.

requirements.text: An existing peering arrangement may need to disband itself if peering is no longer beneficial for the participating CDNs.
conditions: peering is no longer beneficial for the participating CDNs

requirements.text: An existing peering arrangement may need to re-arrange itself if it needs to be expanded further in order to deal with additional load.

requirements.text: Development and validation of peering and manage the complexity of content delivery across Web servers of multiple CDNs that scale across the globe.
requirements.source_sentence: Development and validation of peering and manage the complexity of content delivery across Web servers of multiple CDNs that scale across the globe.

requirements.text: Decrease cost of Web access, increase QoS through reduced latency, reduce server load, and bandwidth consumption (by a particular CDN server), thus improving the performance of content delivery.
